title: Ezra Reads the Law to the People
description: Ezra reads the Law of Moses aloud to all the people at the Water Gate in Jerusalem. The people weep when they hear the words of the law, but are encouraged to rejoice. Then they celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles as written in the law.

versions.title: Ezra's Reading of the Law
versions.description: Ezra reads the Law of Moses aloud to all the people at the Water Gate in Jerusalem, and the people weep when they hear the words of the law and renew their covenant with God.
versions.reason: [minor] description: The description mentions 'renew their covenant with God', but chapter 8 deals primarily with the reading and the Feast of Tabernacles. The renewal of the covenant actually occurs in Nehemiah 9-10. It should be adjusted to reflect that the people also celebrated the Feast of Tabernacles.
